svg.title: Resolve both README facts in the JupyterLab merge editor
svg.desc: 1: Conflicted identifies the README needing a decision. 2: Compare the facts in both side panes. 3: Edit Result to retain degrees and the shortest arc. 4: Mark as resolved saves and stages the edited result.
